title.narrative: ICMPS FUNDACION ECOCIENCIA - ECUADOR V087 SANTIAGO

description.narrative: The Healing Children, Youth and Women Victims of Gender Violence in the Waorani Territory project in Ecuador, implemented by EcoCiencia, aims to contribute to addressing gender-based violence, substance abuse, teenage pregnancies, school dropouts and suicide present among the Waorani People as a process of both reflection and action. The objectives of the grant are to prepare a report regarding the development of training and a comparison between the index of problems in 2023 and the current year, and to lead workshops and coordination meeting with relevant actors for the Waorani people. The key activities include educating at least 100 students, between 12 and 18 years old, on gender-based violence, teenage pregnancies, alcohol consumption, suicide, and school dropouts, and to raise the interest of young people in their own culture, with the participation of the elderly, and include different community groups.
